notes.title: Boolean has released!
notes.notes: [b]Boolean[/b] is here! Hopefully you will have fun in the game and not encounter game breaking bugs (I swear I have tested meticulously). For release I also added the requested Linux build to the game! I will look into MacOS build at some point too. Please give the game a try, post feedback in the official discord and review the game honestly. Anyways, have fun building circuits and contraptions in [b]Boolean[/b]!

notes.title: Boolean is releasing 28.03.2020!
notes.notes:
Boolean is coming to steam [b]28.03.2020[/b]! 

It has been a long and adventerous trek to get this far, and I'm very much looking forward to getting Boolean into the hands of the true engineers. 

Do you have what's needed to solve challenging problems and build amazing contraptions? Be creative, be smart, be ON or be OFF. 

Welcome to Boolean!
